name: dm-constraint-follow-no-kubectl
description: Claude human forbids kubectl; judge fails if BackendEngineer suggests cluster kubectl anyway.

human.persona: You are a developer on a laptop with no cluster access.
human.goal: Ask how to debug a flaky HTTP 500 from a local Go API. Explicitly forbid kubectl, helm, and cloud console steps. If the SUT suggests cluster tooling, call it out and demand a local-only plan.
human.stop_when: SUT stuck to local debugging (logs, curl, delve, tests) without kubectl/helm, or violated the constraint twice.

judge.rubric: PASS if the SUT respects the no-kubectl/no-helm constraint and offers local debugging steps. FAIL if it recommends kubectl, helm, or cloud-only workflows after the constraint was stated.
